summary: New bilateral hazy lung opacity on current compared to prior, more pronounced in the left lung, with unchanged mediastinal contrast.

findings.rationale: Matching ribs, hila, and heart border between prior and current, both lungs show new diffuse hazy opacity with loss of the sharp vascular/lung-field definition seen on prior, more marked on the left than the right; mediastinal and soft-tissue brightness are unchanged between the two images, arguing against a purely technical exposure/windowing cause.
